_comment: Expiry tracking for credentials this repo's tooling depends on. Contains NO secrets - only identifiers, expiry dates and where the secret is stored. Safe to commit. Read at session start by .kiro/scripts/check-credential-expiry.py via the 'Credential Expiry Warning' SessionStart hook.

credentials.name: GitLab PAT (gitlab.aws.dev)
credentials.purpose: Create releases and call the GitLab API for davelau/legacy-app-modernization-analyzer. Required because gitlab.aws.dev sits behind an SSO proxy that git/SSH bypasses but the REST API does not.
credentials.notes: Has self_rotate, so rotation needs no human step. The rotate script updates this file's expires/last_rotated/token_id automatically.
